text:
This is a two player game. Think of a shape, but don't tell the other player what it is. The other player then needs to draw the shape based on your description of it.

Use the vocabulary below to help you describe it:

  • regular/irregular
  • vertex
  • line of symmetry
  • right/obtuse/acute angles
    • parallel sides
  • perpendicular sides

    • Once you've finished, why not swap roles and play again with a different shape?
